pipeline.title: Marrow sets out to challenge genetic medicines for severe blood diseases
pipeline.summary: Armed with $173 million in venture funding, the startup is developing what it’s positioning as a more accessible alternative to gene therapy and gene editing treatments for sickle cell and beta thalassemia.

pipeline.title: Summit shares fall as FDA rejects closely watched PD-1/VEGF drug
pipeline.summary: The FDA refused to overlook ivonescimab’s failure to initially extend survival in a form of lung cancer, setting back Summit’s first chance to win a U.S. approval.

pipeline.title: CG Oncology drug delivers ‘exceptional’ results in key bladder cancer trial
pipeline.summary: CG’s therapy cretostimogene cut the risk of recurrence by 68% when administered after surgery, far surpassing Wall Street’s expectations and lifting company shares.

pipeline.title: J&J bets $2.2B on Ollin’s vision loss drug
pipeline.summary: The deal hands J&J a treatment that could complement its existing eye care franchise, but would vie for share of a crowded and competitive market.

pipeline.title: Lilly adds to buyout streak with $1.5B purchase of startup Calytrix
pipeline.summary: Lilly’s 15th announced company acquisition this year — by far the most in the biopharmaceutical sector — centers around a precision therapy for rare blood disorders known as myeloproliferative neoplasms.

pipeline.title: Big-name investors pour $100M into DNA therapeutics developer Seawolf
pipeline.summary: The startup, which also just disclosed an up to $1.2 billion partnership with Sanofi, is backed by Versant, MPM BioImpact, Eli Lilly and Novartis’ venture arm.

pipeline.title: Completing the circle: the next evolution in sustainable pharmaceutical blister packaging
pipeline.summary: Discover how innovative PET and PP lidding are advancing sustainable pharmaceutical blister packaging.

pipeline.title: Your AI pilots aren’t stalling because of the AI – they’re stalling because of your environment
pipeline.summary: As clinical AI adoption accelerates, trust, traceability and readiness matter more than ever.

pipeline.title: The infrastructure decisions that will enable tomorrow’s biggest breakthroughs
pipeline.summary: Faster drug discovery depends on more than the model. What drug developers need to know about AI.

pipeline.title: One of Europe’s leading VCs banks a €725M ‘crossover’ fund
pipeline.summary: Sofinnova Partners, which has backed the likes of successful drugmakers such as Abivax, Argenx and Verona Pharma, will use the cash to support a new group of later-stage biotechs.
